blocks.text: Connect your apps and automate workflows without writing code

Zapier is the most widely adopted no-code automation platform, connecting over 8,000 apps through simple trigger-action workflows called Zaps. When something happens in one app, Zapier makes things happen in others - automatically, reliably, and without any code.

The platform has matured well beyond simple two-step automations. Multi-step Zaps support branching logic, filters, formatters, and loops. The built-in Tables feature provides a lightweight database for storing and processing data between steps. And Zapier AI lets you build Zaps by describing what you want in plain language.

For startup operations, Zapier often serves as the glue between tools. New lead in Typeform? Route to HubSpot, notify the sales team in Slack, and add a row to your Airtable tracker - all within seconds. This kind of operational automation saves hours every week and eliminates human error from repetitive processes.
The largest app library of any automation platform
Complex workflows with branching logic, filters, and loops
Built-in database for storing data between workflow steps
Describe your automation in plain language and AI builds it
Create forms and pages that trigger automations
Connect AI agents to thousands of apps through the Model Context Protocol

Zapier is the first tool we reach for when building automation workflows for clients. Its breadth of integrations means you can connect virtually any combination of tools, and the reliability is battle-tested at scale.
Our team can integrate Zapier into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
